album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar I

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on E in Qatar. The line peaks at Fs4 (368.7 Hz) at 1:05.8. It closes on A3, not the tonic (E4 → Fs4 → E4 → Fs4 → D4 → A3).

theory_fit.name: Vaziri 24-tone equal temperament

theory_fit.name: Pythagorean / Safi al-Din
theory_fit.description: Nearest note of the 17-note gamut generated by pure fifths (±8) from the tonic.

theory_fit.name: Farhat interval classes
theory_fit.description: Interval classes Hormoz Farhat measured in performance practice ("The Dastgah Concept in Persian Music", 1990). Approximate centres.

flags: tonic G set in the catalog (Bayat-e Tork's finalis G (198.7 Hz): seven of the suite's fourteen tracks voted it and the pitch set fits from it (0, 205, 405, 488, 702, 905, 1052 cents). The vote picked the 4th below, Bayat-e Tork's ist (Farhat 1990, p. 43); Qatar moves in the tetrachord below the finalis (p. 45). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 298.1 Hz (D)
